transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this finalization huddle to review the callback package before I issue the call sheet for the Mara Quill callbacks. We've got Studio 4 booked for June 18, 9 AM to 1 PM, with three finalists still in contention. The package includes the North Wall excerpt, an optional movement exercise, and recorded auditions for internal review. I'd like to go through each of your areas of concern — counsel, stunt, dialect, and studio scheduling — so we can flag any issues before I finalize. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something before we finalize. Yesterday I reviewed the executed streamer casting addendum, and it requires that audition footage be retained for exactly 14 days and accessible only to the named casting team. I haven't entered those terms in the casting tracker yet, but they directly impact our recorded auditions for internal review — we need to make sure access is restricted to the named casting team and that the 14-day retention window is built into our footage handling plan.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a safety issue with the callback plan. My safety review of the locked action brief found that finalists must not perform a fall or handle props at callback. The physical portion must instead be an exactly 8-minute grounded choreography exercise supervised by stunt staff. I have not yet replaced the draft exercise in the call-sheet template, so we need to update that before Maya issues the call sheet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue on the dialect side. After the draft packet circulated, I received the director's revised brief, and it changes two things: first, the callback excerpt should be The Ferry Ledger, not North Wall; second, the role requires Welsh-accented English. I have not yet uploaded the revised brief to the casting folder, so the current package still references North Wall and doesn't reflect the accent requirement. We need to update the excerpt and add the Welsh-accent specification before Maya issues the call sheet.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical scheduling conflict. I confirmed this morning that Studio 4 is closed for a fire-systems test on June 18, so we cannot use that room or that date. The available alternative is Studio 2 on June 20, from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM. This booking change is not yet on the shared calendar, so the current package still shows Studio 4 on June 18 and will need to be updated before Maya issues the call sheet.
transcript.speaker: A5
